assumptions: Logical model abstracts measurements and arithmetic into counters/readiness and nondeterministic outcomes; L3's epoch abstraction is strengthened by concrete runtime identity checks.

Logical non-vacuity is checked on the same bounded abstraction: every antecedent disjunct is reachable, no consequent is invariant on its own, the defensive default branch is unreachable, and each seeded control mutant is detected by its contract.

Dafny verifies real/integer kernels, not the entire Python program or a floating-point compiler refinement. Runtime checks actual observed outputs against exact rational reconstruction within frozen tolerances.
Circuit generation, measurement-basis interpretation, event instrumentation, proof tools, and the independent checker are in the trusted base.
Measurements follow ideal Born probabilities, independent across groups/candidates and executions; within-group correlations are retained.
Gaussian selection is approximate; finite-shot ties use current/minus/plus priority, while the continuous Gaussian model has zero tie probability.
Ideal-energy success is a simulator benchmark oracle, not a hardware-observed stopping certificate.
The 50-update probability is the primary comparison. Other checkpoints and conditional means are supporting marginal comparisons, not a simultaneous-confidence claim.
Group events identify the actual measurement executions
L1.comparison: PROVED and observed obligations satisfied yield AGREEMENT; missing raw evidence is reported explicitly
L1.description: Complete measurements precede candidate energy aggregation
L1.non_vacuity: Stage 1: witness EF aggregate holds and the early-aggregation mutant is detected. Stage 2: Python obligation groups_before_energy fires at every evaluation; DejaVu L1 fires on every energy event, and the two counts must match
L1.stage1: NuXmv L1: aggregate implies three completed groups
L1.stage2: DejaVu L1_groupsBeforeEnergy and Python unique candidate/group completeness

assumptions: Recorded commit events correspond to actual controller boundaries
L2.comparison: A premature observed commit is DISAGREEMENT
L2.description: All three candidate validations precede optimizer commitment
L2.non_vacuity: Stage 1: witnesses EF select and EF commit hold and the skipped-candidate mutant is detected. Stage 2: Python obligations validation_certified (each numericValid) and validations_before_commit (each commit) fire; DejaVu commit and validated counts must match them
L2.stage1: NuXmv L2: selection/commit implies three ready candidates
L2.stage2: DejaVu L2_validationsBeforeCommit and Python certification of each numericValid event

assumptions: Epoch/readiness abstraction preserves current-versus-stale meaning; concrete unique IDs are a runtime strengthening, not a NuXmv proof over arbitrary strings
L3.comparison: Compare freshness with the declared abstraction boundary
L3.description: Evaluation identity and parameter provenance remain current
L3.non_vacuity: Stage 1: witnesses EF commit and EF start hold and the no-reset and stale-energy mutants are detected. Stage 2: Python obligations evaluation_identity_current (each measurement/evaluation/validation) and commit_identity_current (each commit) fire
L3.stage1: NuXmv L3/L3_reset: current epoch and readiness reset
L3.stage2: DejaVu causal links and Python run/update/candidate/index/angle identity checks

assumptions: Ideal-energy success is the benchmark oracle; the logical success flag abstracts this classification
L4.comparison: Missing termination is INCONCLUSIVE; an invalid reason or later activity is DISAGREEMENT
L4.description: Termination is final and has the declared reason
L4.non_vacuity: Stage 1: witnesses for every terminal phase, the last commit, and each termination cause hold; the defensive default branch is unreachable; the budget-to-abort and success-to-abort mutants are detected. Stage 2: Python obligation terminal_reason fires once per closed trace; DejaVu stopped count must match
L4.stage2: DejaVu no activity after stop; Python terminal reason, ideal-success oracle, and update budget

N1.comparison: Valid-input output errors: DISAGREEMENT; invalid inputs: ASSUMPTION_MISMATCH; missing counts: INCONCLUSIVE
N1.description: Raw counts normalize to the reported expectations
N1.non_vacuity: Stage 2: obligation expectation_reconstructed fires for every term of every complete evaluation (4 terms x 3 candidates per update)
N1.stage1: Dafny NormalizeExpectation: positive shots and valid negative counts imply normalization and [-1,1]
N1.stage2: Independent negative-eigenvalue parity counts and exact Fraction expectations

Faithfully instrumented optimizer inputs

N2.description: Declared coefficients and measurements produce the actual energy
N2.non_vacuity: Stage 2: obligation energy_reconstructed fires for every complete candidate evaluation (3 per update)
N2.stage1: Dafny TermEnergyContribution, ComputeTermEnergies, AggregateEnergy and supporting lemmas
N2.stage2: Exact rational reconstruction; compare contributions, score, reported energy and actual optimizer inputs

N4.stage2: Recompute modular candidates and exact-energy argmin with declared tie priority; check bound angles

P1.description: Probability of first success within the update bound
P1.stage1: Storm bounded reachability in the Gaussian DTMC at frozen checkpoints
P1.stage2: First-success proportions from repeated independent finite-shot executions
